_comment: Purchases for the spec/07 section 4 check: 6 tasks, 34 purchases from config/eval-catalog.json, run on devnet by `npm run appe-eval-run` with Spend Guard in shadow mode.

It mixes purchases a reasonable owner would call needed, unneeded, repeated, and "free elsewhere". Which is which is for the owner to judge with `npm run appe-label`; it is deliberately not written here.

A repeated item in one task uses the same URL, so the fixed repurchase rule (10 minutes) asks the owner first; the run cancels that request. The purchase is still reviewed by Spend Guard and labelled.
